text:
Priya S: dropping a compact mock for perf charts. Quick decisions needed so dev can start tomorrow:
- Legend: top inline vs right-rail overflow?
- Tick formatting: humanized (1.2k) vs full (1200)
- Smoothing: visual-only layer vs data-transform (affects annotations)
- Outliers: fade old spikes vs clip+glyph vs label hotspots

Jon B: right-rail easier with many series, but mobile collapse is slightly more work. top inline preferred for single-focus dashboards.

Lena M: my take:
- Default top inline, collapse to rail when >5 series (show "..." chevron).
- Humanized ticks by default; tooltip always shows full raw value. Toggle in chart menu to switch formats.
- Smoothing: visual-only by default with a small badge "Visual smoothing"; don't change alerting data.
- Outliers: alpha-fade older spikes; show distinct red glyph for >99.9th pct and add spike count in legend when present.

Omar H: accessibility notes:
- Humanized ticks confuse screen readers. Mark axis aria-hidden=true and add off-screen element with full numeric ticks for SRs.
- Check color pairs: orange & lime need validation.

design-bot: Contrast check flagged palette variant 2: https://design-reports.internal/contrast/1771246789

Jon B: impl snippets:
```
legend: { placement: 'top', collapseThreshold: 5, overflowMode: 'rail' }
function formatTick(val, mode) { return mode === 'human' ? humanize(val) : val.toLocaleString(); }
```

Priya S: copy for badges/tooltips:
- Smoothing badge tooltip: "Visual smoothing applied; does not affect alerts. Toggle in chart menu."
- Spike glyph tooltip: "Spike: value >99.9th percentile for this timespan. Click to reveal raw points."

Priya S: Decisions pinned:
- Legend: top inline default, collapse to rail when >5 series
- Ticks: humanized default, full number in tooltip + chart menu toggle
- Smoothing: visual-only default with badge
- Outliers: fade old spikes + red glyph for >99.9th pct, legend shows spike count
- Accessibility: offscreen axis text for screen readers, updated color pairs from Omar

Owners: Jon B (legend + ticks), Omar H (accessibility + colors), Lena M (copy + spike tooltip). ETA EOW. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
